"""Final edges: zero-param entries, filter decls, struct arrays, deep exprs."""
import json, subprocess, sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tmp/tests')
from kbuild import *

def run_campaign(campaign):
    r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-I', '-B', '/workspace/project/campaign_cli.py'],
                       input=json.dumps(campaign).encode(), capture_output=True)
    assert r.returncode == 0, r.stderr
    return json.loads(r.stdout)

# zero params, void result, one direct pipe -> flag x0 only, variables 1
types = [{"name": "B", "kind": "bool"}, {"name": "V", "kind": "void"},
         {"name": "Rec", "kind": "struct", "fields": [["ok", "B"]]}]
e = {"name": "e", "params": [], "result": ["v", "V"], "requires": None}
f = {"name": "f", "params": [], "result": ["fr", "B"], "requires": ["const", "B", False]}
campaign = {"types": types, "modules": [e, f], "calls": [], "pipes": [],
            "entries": ["e"], "machine": None, "runs": []}
campaign["pipes"] = [{"target": "e", "filter": "f", "bind": {}}]
campaign["runs"] = [
    {"entry": "e", "ktest": b64(ktest([("x0", le(1, 1))]))},  # f rejects, flag 1 -> FILTERED
    {"entry": "e", "ktest": b64(ktest([("x0", le(0, 1))]))},  # attestation mismatch -> INVALID
    {"entry": "e", "ktest": b64(ktest([]))},                   # missing flag -> INVALID
]
out = run_campaign(campaign)
plan = out['plans'][0]
assert plan['slots'] == [] and plan['flag'] == 'x0' and plan['variables'] == 1, plan
assert [r['status'] for r in out['records']] == ['FILTERED', 'INVALID_TEST', 'INVALID_TEST'], out['records']
assert out['records'][0].keys() == {'status'}
# filter's struct param decl appears in plan types (module order: f before e)
assert plan['types'] == ['Rec'], plan['types']

# struct-array predicate with all + field; filter with struct param bound to entry param
e2 = {"name": "e2", "params": [["rs", "RecArr"]], "result": ["v", "V"], "requires": None}
types2 = [{"name": "B", "kind": "bool"}, {"name": "V", "kind": "void"},
          {"name": "Rec", "kind": "struct", "fields": [["ok", "B"]]},
          {"name": "RecArr", "kind": "array", "element": "Rec", "size": 2}]
f2 = {"name": "f2", "params": [["r", "Rec"]], "result": ["fr", "B"],
      "requires": ["eq", ["field", ["var", "r"], "ok"], ["const", "B", True]]}
pipes2 = [{"target": "e2", "filter": "f2", "bind": {"r": "rs"}}]  # type-mismatch in real life; bind maps param names not arrays -> instead use all-style filter on element? use entry pred instead
mod3 = {"name": "e3", "params": [["rs", "RecArr"]], "result": ["v", "V"],
        "requires": ["all", "r", ["var", "rs"], ["eq", ["field", ["var", "r"], "ok"], ["const", "B", True]]]}
campaign2 = {"types": types2, "modules": [mod3], "calls": [], "pipes": [],
             "entries": ["e3"], "machine": None,
             "runs": [
                {"entry": "e3", "ktest": b64(ktest([("x2", le(1, 1)), ("x4", le(1, 1))]))},
                {"entry": "e3", "ktest": b64(ktest([("x2", le(1, 1)), ("x4", le(0, 1))]))},
             ]}
out2 = run_campaign(campaign2)
plan2 = out2['plans'][0]
assert plan2['slots'] == [["x2", ["rs", 0, "ok"], 1], ["x4", ["rs", 1, "ok"], 1]], plan2['slots']
assert plan2['variables'] == 5
assert [r['status'] for r in out2['records']] == ['READY', 'FILTERED'], out2['records']
assert out2['corpus'][0]['inputs'] == {"rs": [{"ok": True}, {"ok": True}]}

# deep expressions (depth ~64) and deep all nesting
deep = ["var", "n"]
for i in range(30):
    deep = ["not", ["not", deep]]
deep = ["and", deep, ["all", "a", ["var", "rs"], ["all", "b", ["var", "rs"], ["eq", ["field", ["var", "a"], "ok"], ["field", ["var", "b"], "ok"]]]]]
types3 = types2 + [{"name": "N8", "kind": "int", "bits": 8}]
mod4 = {"name": "e4", "params": [["rs", "RecArr"], ["n", "N8"]], "result": ["v", "V"], "requires": deep}
campaign3 = {"types": types3, "modules": [mod4], "calls": [], "pipes": [],
             "entries": ["e4"], "machine": None,
             "runs": [
                {"entry": "e4", "ktest": b64(ktest([("x2", le(1, 1)), ("x4", le(1, 1)), ("x5", le(1, 1))]))},
                {"entry": "e4", "ktest": b64(ktest([("x2", le(1, 1)), ("x4", le(0, 1)), ("x5", le(1, 1))]))},
                {"entry": "e4", "ktest": b64(ktest([("x2", le(1, 1)), ("x4", le(1, 1)), ("x5", le(0, 1))]))},
